ASSOCIATE MANAGER

Hyderabad, India | 8019351538 | lokeshkompala9@gmail.com

PROFILE SUMMARY

Regulatory Reporting (Major Shareholding, Short Selling, Takeover deals), Regulation K, Compliance trade approval, Cash and position reconciliation and corporate actions, Fixed income products & Derivative recon through Tri-Resolve.

Experienced professional with nearly 12+ years of experience in IB operations and Regulatory Reporting & Compliance

Experienced in Major shareholder disclosures, takeover panel reporting, short selling Reporting, and sensitive industry monitoring.

Skilled in position and trade reconciliation, ensuring accurate regulatory filings and compliance with jurisdictional thresholds.

Adept at regulatory change management, tracking new regulations, and implementing process update. • Experienced in MIS reporting and impact analysis for senior management decision-making. • Supported Regulatory Compliance Framework across multiple jurisdictions. • Monitored regulatory obligations and ensured timely escalation of compliance issues. • Assisted internal and external audits through documentation, evidence gathering and regulatory reporting support.

Performed risk assessments on reporting processes and implemented control improvements. • Contributed to Regulatory Change Management initiatives. • Proficient in process automation, testing, and implementing system improvements for regulatory compliance efficiency.

Responsible for UAT project planning like creating testing scenario, test plans, and check list. • Created a Macro by using excel and VBA to automate manual intervention of activities and Experience on creating of dashboards by using ETL tools like Power BI.

Experience on web page and Application automation by using UIPATH (RPA BOT’s) tool. • Knowledge on FCA, Baffin, EMIR,SFTR, Australia, Korea, Thailand, Taiwan and India. • Migrated the cash and stock reconciliations process from State Street Syntel (Pune)to State Street HCL Services successfully.

Compliance Process (Disclosure of interest) successfully transitioned from UK to India in JPMorgan Chase & co.

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

State Street Corporation – Associate Manager - Hyderabad, India

Dec 2024 — Feb 2026

Key Result Areas: Regulatory Reporting, Position & Trade reconciliation, Regulatory Change Management

Disclosing the positional and transactional movements of issuers to respective region regulators based on equity and derivative products trading activity within the stipulated deadline in the regulatory portal (Like FCA, AFM, Taiwan, Korea, Baffin, ASIC).

Supported governance of regulatory reporting processes by ensuring compliance with internal control standards and regulatory requirements.

Produced Management Information (MI) reports highlighting filing volumes, SLA adherence, trends, operational risks, and exceptions for senior stakeholders.

Performed root cause analysis on reporting exceptions and implemented preventive controls to reduce recurring issues.

Collaborated with Compliance, Technology and Operations teams during regulatory changes and production releases.

Participated in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for regulatory reporting enhancements and validated production readiness.

Contributed to process standardization and automation initiatives, improving reporting accuracy and operational efficiency.

Strengthened internal position movement trackers and reconciliation controls to enhance filing accuracy. • Conduct threshold validation and independent shareholding confirmation checks. • Support internal audits and regulatory review queries with structured documentation. • Implement quality assurance reviews to reduce filing errors and operational risk exposure. • Monitoring broker statements on daily and cross verifying with internal systems. • Flagging trade breaches to legal teams and onshore advisory teams. • Providing compliance trade approvals on restricted stocks.

Collaborating with internal LOB teams for trade differences and Trade settlements. • Preparing and submission of Trade & Transactional reporting through trade repositories. • Keenly checking on regulatory thresholds and navigation the regulatory framework • Maintaining the position movement tracker for identifying the discrepancies in position reconciliation. • Supporting LOB team for EMIR transactional reporting based last COB. • Developed and implemented training programs to educate employees on regulatory requirements and compliance responsibilities, enhancing overall awareness and adherence to regulations. • collaborating with internal teams if missing instruction or broker statement for discrepancies • Involved in transition of new funds into internal systems and actively participating in migration process of new

clients

Maintaining the position movement tracker for identifying the discrepancies in position reconciliation • Subject matter support for client queries, regulatory interpretations, and escalation management. • Drive SLA adherence through workflow monitoring and structured KPI tracking. • Support onboarding of new funds and regulatory transitions with zero disruption to BAU services.

JPMorgan Chase & Co – Associate Manager - Hyderabad, India

May 2020 — Nov 2024

Key Result Areas: Regulatory Reporting, Position & Trade reconciliation, Impact Analysis, MIS reporting, Testing and Automation.

Monitored and aggregated global equity positions across multiple jurisdictions (EMEA, APAC) to ensure compliance with Large Shareholder Reporting, Takeover Panel Reporting, and Short Selling regulations. • Supported Regulatory Compliance teams in monitoring regulatory obligations across multiple jurisdictions. • Ensured regulatory reporting activities adhered to internal governance standards, operational risk policies and compliance procedures.

Partnered with Legal, Compliance and Technology teams to implement regulatory change requirements. • Risk Management • Conducted impact assessments for regulatory changes and identified potential operational risks affecting reporting obligations.

Escalated regulatory breaches, reporting exceptions and process control weaknesses through defined governance channels.

Performed impact analysis on firm-wide shareholdings before finalizing regulatory disclosures. • Led rule-based data collation, analytics, and reporting processes to support regulatory inquiries and audits. • Responded to audit and regulatory requests, preparing comprehensive compliance reports and documentation. • Developed and delivered training materials on shareholder disclosure requirements, coordinating training sessions for internal stakeholders.

Created and presented Management Information System (MIS) reports for senior leadership, providing insights into compliance trends and regulatory obligations.

Reviewed, implemented, and enhanced internal control procedures to align with evolving regulatory requirements and new financial products.

Keenly checking on regulatory thresholds and navigation the regulatory framework • Led initiatives to enhance daily monitoring, reporting, and filing workflows, improving operational efficiency. • Developed and implemented training programs to educate employees on regulatory requirements and compliance responsibilities, enhancing overall awareness and adherence to regulations.

Effectively checking the movement of percentage holdings and notifying to the respective regulators which is relates to short selling, Major shareholding in given threshold based on jurisdiction

Jun 2016 — May 2020

process updates.

Sep 2013 — Dec 2015

Sep 2013 — Dec 2015

Key Result Areas: Cash and position, Reconciliation, Corporate actions, Paydowns • Experience in reconciliation process pertaining to cash and Position recon. • Knowledge in matching the breaks and routing it to the responsible teams. • Investigation and review of breaks to identify the root cause to clear at the earliest and well versed in resolution

management.

Identify the miscellaneous payments and routing it to the responsible teams • Settling and reconciling the corporate actions which includes Dividends, pay-downs coupon issue using an application of MCH (Multi currency horizon).

Analyze unique and recurring situations and derive a solution to continuously improve process Update and follow the tracking mechanism log the errors and ensure timely correction of faults so that the recon process adhere to the specified timelines.

Updating the trackers to provide and complete the workflow with accuracy and quality. • Preparing Client required reports like MIS and Consolidate reports on daily and monthly basis and sending it to the Client.

TECH SKILLS & FUNCTIONAL SKILLS

Knowledge on creating excel and VBA macro to automate manual intervention of activities • Proficiency in Power BI for creating of dashboards • Created a BOT for positional reconciliation by using VBA. • Hands on experience on UIPATH(RPA Tool) to automate any kind of structured and unstructured data • Beginner knowledge on SQL queries. • Regulatory Compliance • Regulatory Change Management • Risk & Controls • Operational Risk • Compliance Monitoring • Root Cause Analysis • Process Improvement • UAT

ACOMPLISHMENTS

Automated position recon with EXCEL and VBA macros and it avoid manual intervention. • Effectively participated in automation of TLM • Reduced regulatory reporting exceptions through implementation of enhanced reconciliation controls. • Improved reporting turnaround time by automating manual compliance activities. • Successfully supported multiple regulatory migrations with zero audit observations. • Developed executive dashboards improving visibility of regulatory KPIs and operational risks. • Enhanced governance reporting through automated MI and exception tracking. • Received 3 outstanding performer Awards in Invesco for effectively maintaining the fund without any error in team and handled Darwin project, REDOM Projects and automation of TLM and Excel macros

Received 2 times Triple service excellence award from State Street for managed multiple type funds with error free in State Street HCL services. • Received appreciation from client for effectively organizing my work and raising outstanding exceptions in timely manner.

ACADEMIC PROFILE

Master of Business Administration (Finance) - JNTU, Anantapur - 75% Bachelor of Commerce, Sri Venkateswara University, Tirupati. - 76%

2011- 2013 2008 -2011

PROJECTS

Darwin Project— ETD & OTC position recon Automation



Led the end-to-end automation of the daily ETD and OTC position reconciliation process, eliminating manual intervention and improving operational efficiency.

Designed and implemented an automated workflow that consistently produced accurate and audit-ready

reconciliation results, aligning fully with the previous manual process.



Reduced overall processing time significantly by streamlining data comparison, exception identification, and reporting, enabling faster break resolution and improved productivity for the team.

Metrics & Major Shareholding project

Developed an automated solution using UiPath to perform Independent Shareholding Confirmation (ISC) validation directly from multiple data sources, enhancing accuracy and timeliness of regulatory reporting.

Created standardized and scalable metric templates to capture data volumes, trends, and exception

patterns, improving management information reporting and decision support.



Built a custom Excel macro to log, track, and audit the number of activities, disclosures, and submissions processed on any given date, strengthening transparency and governance.

Eagle Star (ReDOM)— Cash & position recon Automation



Successfully transitioned complex data sets from the legacy application to the new ReDOM platform, ensuring full data integrity and continuity of business operations.

Authored comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the new application environment,

improving process consistency, onboarding efficiency, and audit compliance.

Automated the broker and custody position reconciliation process within ReDOM, significantly reducing

manual effort while improving accuracy and timeliness of reconciliation outputs.

Darwin Project— ETD & OTC position recon Automation

Led the end-to-end automation of the daily ETD and OTC position reconciliation process, eliminating manual intervention and improving operational efficiency.
Designed and implemented an automated workflow that consistently produced accurate and audit-ready

Authored comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the new application environment,
improving process consistency, onboarding efficiency, and audit compliance.
Automated the broker and custody position reconciliation process within ReDOM, significantly reducing
manual effort while improving accuracy and timeliness of reconciliation outputs.

PROJECTS
Darwin Project— ETD & OTC position recon Automation

Led the end-to-end automation of the daily ETD and OTC position reconciliation process, eliminating manual intervention and improving operational efficiency.
Designed and implemented an automated workflow that consistently produced accurate and audit-ready
reconciliation results, aligning fully with the previous manual process.

Reduced overall processing time significantly by streamlining data comparison, exception identification, and reporting, enabling faster break resolution and improved productivity for the team.
Metrics & Major Shareholding project
Developed an automated solution using UiPath to perform Independent Shareholding Confirmation (ISC) validation directly from multiple data sources, enhancing accuracy and timeliness of regulatory reporting.
Created standardized and scalable metric templates to capture data volumes, trends, and exception
patterns, improving management information reporting and decision support.

Built a custom Excel macro to log, track, and audit the number of activities, disclosures, and submissions processed on any given date, strengthening transparency and governance.
Eagle Star (ReDOM)— Cash & position recon Automation

Successfully transitioned complex data sets from the legacy application to the new ReDOM platform, ensuring full data integrity and continuity of business operations.
Authored comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the new application environment,
improving process consistency, onboarding efficiency, and audit compliance.
Automated the broker and custody position reconciliation process within ReDOM, significantly reducing
manual effort while improving accuracy and timeliness of reconciliation outputs.
